title: EP02. 해달 겨드랑이 속 '평생 쓰는 돌'?

narration: 해달한테 평생 쓰는 돌이 있다고요? 반은 틀렸어요!
scenes.title:
해달의 평생 돌?
**반은 틀렸어요**
scenes.motion: The otter turns the stone slowly in its paws and blinks in amazement. The red question mark bounces softly. Gentle waves.
scenes.image_prompt: The mascot floats on its back at the water surface, holding up a smooth round gray stone with both paws and staring at it in amazement, a big glossy red question mark floating above the stone. Calm cool blue-green North Pacific water, warm golden morning light.

scenes.title: **오늘의 궁금증**
scenes.motion: The otter bobs gently on the water, looks at the viewer with a curious smile and taps its notebook with the pencil. Sunlight glitters on the waves, the kelp in the corner sways softly.

narration: 해달 앞다리 아래엔 늘어진 피부 주머니가 있어요.
바다 밑에서 주운 조개랑 돌을 여기 넣고 올라와요.
scenes.title:
진짜예요:
**앞다리 아래 주머니**
scenes.motion: The otter lifts its front leg a little higher to show the pocket, the stone inside wiggles slightly, then it looks at the viewer proudly. Gentle waves.
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up: the mascot floats on its back at the water surface and lifts one front leg to show a loose fold of furry skin under its forearm, like a small pocket in its armpit (not on the belly). A smooth gray stone and a small clam peek out of that armpit fold. Proud, curious expression. Cool blue-green water, soft overcast light.

narration: 물 위에 누워 배에 돌을 올리고,
마음에 드는 돌은 한동안 들고 다니기도 하고요.
scenes.title:
배 위에서 **탕탕!**
돌로 조개 깨기
scenes.motion: The otter taps the clam on the stone on its belly three times, small splashes rise, a piece of shell falls off. It bobs gently on the water.
scenes.image_prompt: The mascot floats on its back at the water surface with a flat gray stone resting on its belly, holding a clam in both paws and tapping it on the stone. Small water splashes and tiny cracked shell pieces. Floating golden-brown kelp nearby, a rocky cold-water coastline far in the background, no coral. Cool morning light.

narration: 그런데 평생 한 개만 쓴다는 건 과장이에요.
돌을 거의 안 쓰는 해달도 있거든요.
해달마다 도구 쓰는 정도가 아주 다르대요.
scenes.title:
평생 한 돌?
**과장이에요**
scenes.motion: The left otter taps a clam on its stone, the right otter nibbles the sea urchin, the small otter with the blue scarf tilts its head and writes in its notebook. Kelp sways slowly.
scenes.image_prompt: Three sea otters float on their backs at the surface of a cold North Pacific kelp forest. Left: a plain gray-brown sea otter with no scarf cracking a clam on a stone on its belly. Right: another plain gray-brown sea otter with no scarf eating a purple sea urchin with its paws, using no tool. At the lower edge of the frame: the mascot (the only one with the blue scarf) holding its tiny yellow notebook, looking at them thoughtfully. Every otter has one head and one normal body. Soft overcast light.

narration: 도구를 자주 쓰는 해달은 이빨이 덜 상했대요.
scenes.title:
도구 쓰면
**이빨이 덜 상해요**
scenes.motion: The otter smiles wider, a small sparkle flashes on its teeth, and it holds the stone up proudly. Gentle waves.
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up: the mascot floats at the water surface and gives a big happy smile that shows small healthy white teeth with a tiny sparkle, holding a smooth gray stone next to its cheek like a proud trophy. Cool blue-green water, warm light.

narration: 평생 돌 말고, 잘 맞는 돌!
scenes.title:
~~평생 쓰는 돌~~
**잘 맞는 돌**
scenes.motion: The otter draws a line across the notebook with its pencil, writes a new line underneath, then looks up with a proud smile. Gentle waves.

scenes.title:
다음 궁금증
**댓글로 알려주세요**
scenes.motion: The otter waves its paw at the viewer twice and smiles, bobbing softly on the water. Sunlight sparkles on the waves.

motion_suffix: Static camera, no zoom, no cuts. Gentle, natural, slow motion. Keep the character's appearance, light sky-blue scarf and tiny yellow notebook exactly the same as the first frame. No text, no new characters, no new objects. Vertical 9:16.
motion_negative: text, subtitles, extra limbs, extra otters, morphing face, camera shake, zoom
image_prompt_prefix: Use the attached character sheet as the exact reference for the main character: a small chubby sea otter mascot with dark chocolate-brown fur, cream face, round black eyes, blush cheeks, a light sky-blue knitted scarf with a white wavy pattern, and a tiny yellow spiral notebook. Keep the same face, colors and proportions. Soft 3D render. Vertical 9:16. No text, no letters.
